name: Room 400
source:
Static, a voice demanding you find your way out, and a strange room you've never seen before.

Room 400 is a short kinetic novel with point and click elements about the unfortunate subject 38 as he is forced to figure out how to escape room 400.

[From [url=https://zeddy-bear.itch.io/room-400]Itch.io[/url]]
